UserDexProfile.title: UserDexProfile
UserDexProfile.description: Stores a trainer's Pokédex catching progress, regional variant catches, Living Box variant selections, Living Box game origin selections, per-game catches, owned games, shiny progress, Living Dex box state, owned DLC expansions, specimen inventory instances with POKEIDs, and public stats page visibility.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

trainerName.description: Display name or custom trainer handle.

isPublic.description: Whether the trainer has enabled a public shareable Living Dex stats page.

caughtIds.description: Bounded list of caught National Pokédex IDs (1 to 1025).

shinyIds.description: Bounded list of caught Shiny National Pokédex IDs (1 to 1025).

livingIds.description: Bounded list of Living Dex boxed National Pokédex IDs (1 to 1025).

caughtVariants.description: Bounded list of caught regional variation IDs (e.g., 37:base, 37:alola).

boxSelectedVariants.description: Bounded list of selected regional variation IDs displayed in Living Dex Box slots.

boxSelectedGames.description: Bounded list of single selected game origin per Pokémon for Living Dex Box slots (e.g., 25:swsh).

ownedGames.description: Bounded list of game IDs (GBA Gen III to Switch Gen IX + Pokémon GO) owned by the trainer.

ownedDlcs.description: Bounded list of DLC identifiers owned by the trainer.

gameCatches.description: Map of gameId to bounded array of caught National Dex IDs in that specific game.

inventory.description: Bounded list of caught specimen instances with unique 12-char POKEIDs, levels, nicknames, origin game or HOME gift, and trade status.

caughtCount.description: Total number of standard Pokémon caught.

shinyCount.description: Total number of shiny Pokémon caught.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/userDexProfiles/{userId}.description: Per-user Pokédex tracking document indexed by Firebase Auth UID, with optional opt-in public read for sharing Living Dex stats.
